notes.title: 🚜 Update 1.9.2 – Vehicle Switching Overhaul!
notes.content:
Hello Miners! ⚒️

We’ve just overhauled the Vehicle Switching System – and it’s a game-changer for how you dig, drive, and dominate the claim.

No more guessing. No more clicking through random machines.
Now you’re in control.


What’s new in 1.9.2? 😎


➡️ Pick your ride – when you want

Forget cycling through every vehicle. Now you choose exactly which machine to hop into – fast and easy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/0328b4d33cd9f26b0f5962ceb8d72c4b1855b683.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/d07de487fb5c3b7cbb5d972c8220fa2dc2890810.gif"]

Every machine now shows how far it is from you – plus a handy direction marker so you always know where to head next.

notes.title: Season 39 kicks off today in Gold Mining Simulator! 🔥
notes.content:
Hello, Miners! ⚒️


Things are about to get exciting! Because Today at 9AM Pacific Time (PT), Season 39 starts in Gold Mining Simulator! It's time to gear up and have some fun! ⌚


🔥 What’s new for this season?🔥

So, what awaits? Let's see! 😎

We have been working on the transport container, to improve the transporting quality. Now you can load it up with items like cables, buckets, and more — then move the whole thing to another claim using the transport menu. Simple as that! 💪

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/d713a55e44aabdd6c6096b1dc215134da55c3413.jpg"]

Another thing that has been improved is the process of transporting machines. Now you can transport all the items in container in the transport window with just one click. 🖱️

Remember that there was an issue with texture resolution — when digging or dumping dirt, weird square patches would show up on the ground? Now it's fixed! No more squares after digging 😎
it works after the reset of the parcel and on the new saves.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/f4ea37e1b8c9559a0e111ae60e512550e083ce09.jpg"]

We have also fixed the FPS matter. Now the game should run smoother and more efficent. 

We took a closer look at the restore function and gave it an upgrade — it now properly puts the Cordylus and Mini Excavator back together if they get glitched.


A good news for aesthetic fans. New pair of skins arrives!
Remember Miners! In this season rewards are for top 50 for DLC and top 10 for non DLC! 

Collect all 22 crates and you’ll unlock the Quad Hot Rod. And if you rank top 50 on the leaderboard at the end of the season, you’ll earn the Neon skin for the Small Excavator!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/5b14380f68a939c7cb8019112ea70576fc198a1d.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/196f97b3b105f34f3b3f213719d41a32ffa3511c.jpg"]
 This seasonal parcel is Nighthawk!

 Changelog [1.9.0]:
➕[Added] Transport container,

➕[Added] Transport all machines with one click,

🛠️[Fixed] Stable improved FPS,

🛠️[Fixed] Squares of dirt on parcel after dropping dirt (on new saves and after reset),

🛠️[Fixed] Player camera shaking on uneven ground,

🛠️[Fixed] Mats and grills won't be charged when in rented machines,

🛠️[Fixed] Player won't be peeking out of the vehicles anymore,

🔄[Changed] Transport machines by clicking on them in transport window,

🔄[Changed] Restore function on Cordylus and mini Excavator will now put machine together if glitched.

notes.title: Welcome to Gold Mining Simulator 2`s steampage! 👋
notes.content:
Hello, Miners! 👋

With great pleasure we want to welcome you on Gold Mining Simulator 2’s steam page! Whether you're a seasoned prospector or just starting your journey, get ready to dig deep, refine your techniques, and strike it rich, as Gold Mining Simulator is coming to a different level - this time, with your friends in a multiplayer mode! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885380/Gold_Mining_Simulator_2/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/4bc83c527494628b284cba19485869e185becdc6.png

What's coming with Gold Mining Simulator 2? 📢  
We aim to create GMS 2 with passion and respect to all of our fans - what's the most important, the game will be based on the analyzed feedback of our playerbase. With the strong base of the already existing Gold Mining Simulator, we want to meet your expectations and add our own ideas. 

What has happened so far? 📅 
Since the new team joined the company at the end of 2023 and took over the project, we have switched the engine from UE4 to UE5. 💥 This took a considerable amount of time, but it was necessary, as we want to support the game for a long time and expand it with future expansions! 🎁 We've also added a new map, NPCs, sidequests, changed approach to Gold support and communication. 🏆

Communication 💬 
Communication with our player is the most important factor for us. We want to communicate directly and frequently, which is why we’ve hired a new Community Manager specifically for the players. There will be plenty of devlogs about the game's development as well! If you want to be a part of the game's development, give us feedback and ideas and talk to the devs directly - join our Discord.
📢 The German player base has a significant percentage share in GMS 1. We appreciate it, and from now on, all news will also be available in German! 📢

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/5207273f881e65d6e349c8b3810b6b720b91b083.png

🎬 Join our live Q&A stream on YouTube (03.02 at 17:00 CET) to discuss the Steam page, trailer, and your questions! You cannot miss this! 

Don’t forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist - it will let us know that you’re really hyped about it, and above all, will let you be up to date with everything related to GMS2! 

You can sign up for the playtests now on Steam - please note, that they are not starting right away. After signing up you will be notified once they start, so stay tuned for the annoucenements. There may be more playtests in the future - let’s see how it goes!

notes.title: ⛏️ Development for 2025: Our Roadmap! 🗺️
notes.content:
Hello, miners! 👋

Thanks to your feedback and support, Gold Mining Simulator gets better and better with every update. We know how much you value transparency, so we want to share with you our plans for the upcoming year! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/04cd0557e2f69fdf9d9c3f957b342a9b7d80d30f.jpg

We’ve prepared a list of changes and new features we plan to introduce in 2025. 📋 It’s the result of many discussions, analyses, and feedback we’ve received from you. Please note that the upcoming features are not listed in any order. We will do our best to deliver them as planned, as we don’t want to disappoint you. 💪

Gold Mining Simulator Roadmap 2025


 [New] Official support for joysticks
 [New] Indicator showing rented machines 
 [New] New machine - Fuel truck
 [Fix] Bulldozer terrain cutting efficiency
 [New] New machine - Big bulldozer
 [New] New machine -  Backhoe loader
 [New] Ability to setup the Orange Beast on every parcel 
 [Fix] Quad improvements – more power, selling option, trailer hitch
 [Fix] Cordylus improvements – faster rotation and added hopper
 [New] Ability to use Cordylus with dumptruck
 [Fix] Comprehensive planter bug fixes
 [Fix] Camera clipping through ground while digging 
 [Fix] Steam Achievements overhaul – verifying and ensuring proper functionality 
 [Fix] Waterfall Valley bedrock bug 
 [New] Vehicles switching system overhaul
 [New] Saving highlighted areas between sessions
 [New] New item - Dynamite
 [New] Ability to carry multiple mats and mosses at once 
 [New] New item - Transport container integrated with the in-game transport system
 [New] Drill indicator
 [Fix] Tree shader improvements
 [Fix] Increased visibility of water in bucket
 [New] Shovel skins
 [Update] Shader system overhaul – smaller files for quicker updates and faster loading
 [Update] Game engine update – improved performance and easier content updates
 [Update] Improved driving system for better machine control


GOLD MINING SIMULATOR 2 is coming!
With great pleasure we want to welcome you on Gold Mining Simulator 2’s steam page! Whether you're a seasoned prospector or just starting your journey, get ready to dig deep, refine your techniques, and strike it rich, as Gold Mining Simulator is coming to a different level - this time, with your friends in a multiplayer mode! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885380/Gold_Mining_Simulator_2/

An independent team is working on GMS 2, on top of the one that already supports GMS1 in smaller numbers.
Our intention is to develop GMS2, but we do not want to leave our 7-year-old community without support. Therefore, in addition to open communication about GMS2, we want to treat GMS1 players fairly and still support the game. Stay tuned. Really soooon you will see more materials!!!


We’re always open to your feedback – if you have suggestions or additional ideas you’d like to see in the game, let us know in the comments! 💬 
Remember, we’ll keep you updated on our progress and any changes to the schedule. 🛠️

notes.title: Wow! 1 million ore!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/778457a6c0d3249248e121a69388ec0fef6a581a.png

"Gold Mining Simulator" Sets New Record! Player xlr8 Achieves Incredible Success, Mining Over 1 Million Ounces of Gold in a Single Season!

In the recently concluded PC season, xlr8 stunned everyone by mining over a million ounces of gold—an achievement no one had previously come close to. In an interview with our studio, xlr8 revealed that the inspiration behind this accomplishment was a challenge set by another player, Splitintwo. After losing his job, xlr8 dedicated most of his time to the game, playing 10-15 hours a day and achieving an impressive 4,000 ounces of gold per hour in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/47249af663a2dbd0a02e92d69418e09390fc902f.gif

When the leaderboard appeared on players' screens, we were all shocked and full of admiration for this achievement. Speaking about his record, xlr8 humorously remarked, "It looks a bit over the top," but there's no denying that his success is extraordinary.

Asked for advice for those aiming to surpass his record, xlr8 emphasized the need for immense dedication and perseverance. "It's really hard to play a game 10-15 hours a day. If someone is willing to put in that effort and can mine faster than me, then I salute them," said xlr8.

This record-breaking feat by xlr8 will surely inspire other players to take on challenges and strive for new goals in "Gold Mining Simulator." Will anyone be able to surpass this record? Only time will tell!

Entire interview:


 M: Would you like to share with us some background how did you achieve it?
 xlr8: I can, yes. It all started with Splitintwo said something like if someone gets 1 million oz he would come back, so I made all the calculations to see if I could actually do it and I could. I just lost my job, so I have all the time in the world to play right now. That's why I did 1 million oz. I just played 10-15 hours a day with my 4k Oz gold per IRL hour.
 M: Our whole studio was shocked when we have seen the leaderboard yesterday.
 xlr8:  Haha it looks a bit too much, yes.
 M: Any advice for someone trying to break your record?
 xlr8: Haha.. It's really hard to play a game 10-15 hours per day, if someone is willing to do that and be faster than me at digging, I salute them.

notes.title: Great update and big changes
notes.content:
Dear Gold Seekers,

We are thrilled to announce that significant changes are coming to the world of Gold Rush: The Game, changes that will transform the way you experience treasure hunting in the wilds of Alaska. 
From April 1, 2024, we are stepping into an entirely new chapter that will redefine your adventure in the quest for gold.

First and foremost, we would like to unveil that our beloved game will adopt a completely new name, one that captures the spirit and character of what it means to be a true gold prospector. Alongside the new name, we are introducing a fresh visual overhaul that will breathe new life into the game world and make every detail even more captivating.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/7c5e3f665450ea7dd90ff946f8218162b8cfd1a8.png

But that's not all. This massive update is not just about rebranding and visual refreshment. It also entails a deep revamp of the gameplay itself. We are fixing bugs, introducing new features, and delivering content that will rejuvenate your adventures. NEW DLC is comming!

However, the most exciting part of this update is that it will be rolled out across all platforms simultaneously! Yes, you heard it right - whether you're playing on PC or console, you will be able to enjoy the same incredible gaming experience. The console update will be on par with the PC version, ensuring all players can explore the same terrains and tackle the same challenges.

But that's just the tip of the iceberg. With this update on Playstation and Xbox, we are also introducing the long-awaited seasons and rewards. Now your experience with Gold Rush: The Game will be even more dynamic, with varying weather conditions and challenges that change throughout the year.

We know you've been eagerly anticipating this update, so we are pleased to announce that we expect to roll it out in the first half of the second quarter of 2024. Get ready for new challenges, new discoveries, and new adventures!

Thank you for your support and dedication in the pursuit of gold. Together, we will make history!

Sincerely,
The Gold Rush: The Game Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.7.0
notes.content:
Dear Miners,
Today we will be releasing a hotfix that address an invisible quad in the part shop issue and as well update to the steam cloud saving. Now steam cloud shouldn't turn OFF automatically after exiting a game. We've made a small tutorial on how to properly enable steam cloud and how to do backup for your game files.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/1e89b51785c419c839b28a6d53f63d0bcdae8d87.png

Please before turning ON steam cloud saves make sure to backup your save files!!

How to create a backup for your save files:
[olist]
 Open file explorer and go to: %localappdata%low\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Saves
 Copy the entire folder called "Saves" to your desktop - DO NOT CUT IT, JUST COPY!
 That's it, now follow the other steps to enable Steam Cloud saves
[/olist]
How to enable Steam Cloud Saving:
[olist]
 Go to your Steam library
 Right click on a Gold Rush: The Game then click properties
 In the General tab you need to check the steam cloud option
 You can now exit the tab
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/c3b490815b5c65cfcfc7028f9e101cc20ee38eb4.png

Now it should automatically put your save files that you have on your local storage to the steam cloud, and it will update it every time you will exit your game. If it's says that the steam cloud is not synchronised just click on it and click retry synchronising, now it should upload properly.

If you encounter any issues please contact us on Discord server and we will try to help you. Thank you!

notes.title: Consoles update
notes.content:
Hello Miners!

As promised - more info about X1 and PS4 ports below - there’s also something for PC fans!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=505Ztf6bMgw

What to expect from X1 and PS4 versions?

1:1 port of gold mining experience from PC,
entire gameplay content released so far,
2 years of updates and fixes already in.

As you might know the end of the year in game dev industry is pretty intense. Our studio is making sure that the upcoming release is thoroughly checked for any possible issues. Quality improvements should be also experienced in PC version. 

What delays us the most is continuous synchronization between living PC game and the upcoming ports. We know that we tentatively announced ports for Q4 2019, but there are 2 essential steps ahead of us:

Certification testing (mandatory for publishing the game on consoles)
Setting release date with all partners (not only publishers – it’s a licensed product after all)


Those are the main reasons why we have to delay the release (unofficially to Q1 2020) – and for that we are truly sorry. We are totally aware that you are waiting for console version for such a long time – we can promise that you’ll be the first to know if there’s ANY new info.

Be sure that we will continue to support PC version and leaderboard system. You keep sending us so many amazing ideas, it would be shame not to use them to create more content!

And again - thank you for your continuous support – there’s no Gold Rush without you!

P.S. There’s Xmas gift for everyone with PC version - we planned Free DLC event with one of our existing DLCs – please stay tuned for more info.

notes.title: INTO THE FUTURE
notes.content:
Hi Miners!

TL;DR we will post more often, ports are coming, maybe new content as well.

THE PAST
2019 was a tough year for us - supporting Gold Rush with new content,
introducing leaderboards and releasing another game was a bit too much for us.

The result was predictable - we released less, we were not happy with quality
and communication was poor. We are truly sorry - you guys just deserve more!

After many internal debates, we decided to focus 100% on Gold Rush.
The plan was to deliver complete experience - with all the patches, fixes and
content released for 2 years.

THE FUTURE
Starting next week, we will deliver continous updates on ports progress - we are almost there.
It will contain all the stuff from PC version.

After that, we will focus on delivering more updates for all the platforms.

Thank you for being with us even when times were rough.

Let's mine some gold!

notes.title: AMD crashes since last update - help us solve the issue!
notes.content:
Hello Players!

We are aware that some of you might be experiencing crashes since the last Update. From your reports, we are able to suspect it has something to do with AMD Radeon GPUs and new Unity update. We're now in contact with AMD to resolve this issue.
To help us deal with the problem, we'd kindly ask those of you who have AMD Radeon GPUs to send us an e-mail at bugs@goldrush-thegame.com (Title: AMD Crash) with the following files:
- output_log, 
- error.log, 
- crash.dmp,
- video of the crash.

Here's how to find them:

Output_log
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotes '%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame'

Error.log, crash.dmp
Once the game crashes, it will provide a log file, which can be found by following the steps below:
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotation marks: "%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Crashes"
• The crash folder will have the name of a date for example - 2018-02-12_151020 
Important: restarting the game will delete the crash log files.

or alternatively:
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotation marks: "%temp%\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Crashes"

Video of the crash
Videos can be recorded with popular recording software such as OBS, Xsplit, AMD ReLive, etc.
You can upload the videos on wetransfer.com (or other services) and send us the link.

Thanks in advance for your help! With such files, it will be easier for us to help.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 1.5.3 is LIVE - Leaderboards 2, new item, tool, worker, reinforced parts, and more!
notes.content:
Hello Gold Miners!
Update 1.5.3 is LIVE and it brings:

Leaderboards Season 2
Overseer
Reinforced Parts
Transport Crate
Parts Analyzer
New random events
Balance changes
Internet radio integration
And more!


Watch the trailer:
https://youtu.be/mJvlKaZNAZo

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/095ed477482fba6a5c96b1b70bc6832873fcd440.gif
Leaderboards Season 2
Compete against other Players to become one of the greatest mine bosses! Now with the new Seasonal Gold parameter.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/b906a29174ecd4313cc9ca6516057ea04f096f00.gif
Overseer
The new worker is here to help you manage your gold mine more effectively. Get notifications when parts reach low durability or when Wash Plant elements (like mats) are full. Find out more about Tier 1-3 effects below.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/6486d92ba12caace92a37a96a2016a0b6e72ca82.gif
Reinforced Parts
All breakable parts received their reinforced substitutes. They last longer, but come with greater costs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/308dc783c9987c3160458e8e529fec0598d6705c.gif
Transport Crate
Meet the Transport Crate - the greatest convenience item since the invention of the microwave. With this new equipment, you will be able to hold and carry multiple items at once.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/9d3f8bd65db91f94742dfac63ae7ffe644e49b97.gif
Parts Analyzer
Allows you to easily check the current durability of selected parts. Simply approach the working machine and select Parts Analyzer.

Internet Radio integration
Listen to your favorite streaming radios while digging!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1714102451
Changes:

Added the reinforced set of breakable parts, which have greater durability, but also a greater price. They can be distinguished by a different color. Players can now choose to use more expensive parts, which will last longer. Reinforced parts are available in the Store.
Added Wooden Crates. Players can use them to carry multiple items at the same time.
Added new Tool: Parts Analyzer, which can be used to check the durability of the part it points at.
Added new Worker: Overseer (see Tier 1-3 effects below).
Added new random events (see the full list below).
Added internet radio integration. Check out the guide above to learn how to activate it.
Pickup Truck is now moved next to the player after being teleported to the Hotel when Permafrost hits.
Pickup Truck no longer breaks when the Permafrost hits.
The Headlight lightning now works as Flashlight, but with greater brightness. You can carry the equipment with the Headlight on.
Removed Flashlight from the toolbar.
Changed default Tools' changing to mouse's scroll wheel.
Magnetite Separator stops processing dirt when the bucket is full (just like the Gold Nuggetator).
Added 12-hour game time display option in the Settings -> Game -> Clock Time.
Added information about the fuel consumption to the Store.
Added a new button to the Generator: Start All.
Workers are paid at midnight.
Loan daily payments are collected at midnight.
Statistics are checked at midnight, no matter at what time they are displayed to the Player.
The randomization of workers in Retrain Workers option now works as drawing a new one (from the pool of available machines).
Added the possibility of the Fuel Station running out of fuel.
Added prompt informing about the engine being turned off when trying to use Excavator's arm.
Made it possible to enter the Power Generator without jumping.
Changed Map's moving icons.
Added new valves to Water Towers. 
Adjusted pan's collider to fit the bowl more accurately.
Added Fuel Tank's opening sound.
Added the possibility to open Fuel Tank's cap.
Small Electric Water Pump's cap is now automatically opened before refueling.
Added closing animations to lids and caps.
Added new notification when the engine has been turned off but the lights are still on.
Changed Magnetite's selling prompt text.
Reduced the required amount of cables being attached in one of the Tutorial tasks from 4 to 3.
Changed Wash Plant's elements snapping during setup on the Easy Mode. The correct rotation of the element is no longer necessary.
Added more markers in the Tutorial to the Trommel, the Bank during the Claim upgrade task, the Front-End Loader, Duplex Jig buckets, and ST Sluicebox buckets.
Added new Tutorial task, which requires Players to sell the Gold Bar in the Tutorial.
Changed wording in keybindings for the Excavator: one part of the Bucket has been renamed to Thumb, Big Arm to Boom, and Small Arm to Stick.
Adjusted tree branch on Old Arnold's small digging site.
Added Tool icons and associated keybindings to the in-game Show Controls menu.
Limited fuel stations nozzle's hose length.
Disabled random events in the tutorial.
ST Sluicebox is now the first equipment to be set up in the tutorial.
Pickup Truck no longer uses fuel in the tutorial until the first refueling.
Added Romanian Pickup Truck skin.
Added Leaderboards Pickup Truck skin to Top10 Players accounts.


Leaderboards Season 2
For the second season of gold mining competition, we are adding a new parameter: best Gold per Season ratio (Seasonal Gold). The game will count the highest amount of gold dug during any of the in-game seasons (full year). The score will be updated whenever Player gets a better score, so it will be continuously updated during the first in-game season, and then it will start updating again when Player reaches better score than during the first in-game season.
In other words, Players will now be competing in two leaderboards (Max Gold and Seasonal Gold), and the TOP10 lists may differ depending on the parameter. Winners will again be rewarded with a new special vehicle skin.

 In Leaderboards Mode, the gold gathered in buckets will be counted towards the current season's  Seasonal Gold value. This will prevent gold from being stored in buckets for the subsequent seasons in order to get better results.
 Added option to switch the display between to parameters: Overall Amount of Gold Dug and Gold/Season Ratio.
 Leaderboards are now scrollable.


Overseer:

Tier 1: Shows notification when the part reaches 0.3 durability. Adds a Yellow version of the outline when below 0.3 and not yet destroyed (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Prevents equipment theft random event from happening.
Tier 2: Adds Red ray over the destroyed machine to be more noticeable from far away. Increases the Outline visibility range of destroyed/almost destroyed parts by x2,5 (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 50% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
Tier 3: Adds notification when any element of the Wash Plant system is full. Makes parts outline gradually change their color depending on their current durability. Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 100% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).


New random events
Every day there's a 5% chance that one of the new random events will occur at 4 am (or when the Player gets up). Each of the events has its own chance factor of happening, meaning that if a random event is triggered, some events will be more likely to occur than others:

Theft of a single random part from a machine - 10%.
Destruction of a single part from a machine - 10%.
Theft of the fuel (emptying the fuel tank) - 15%.
A single random employee quits - 25%.
Theft of 5% of gathered Gold (gathered during a single day) - 10%.
Theft of 10% of earned Money - 0% (the event can no longer happen).
Laptop's malfunction - it does not work for a single day - 25%.
No fuel on the Fuel Station - not possible to use it for a single day - 5%.

In other words: there is a 5% chance every day that a random event will occur. If it does, there is a 25% chance that it will be a laptop's malfunction, 10% chance that it will be a Part's Theft, etc.

Balance:

Decreased Bank loan interest rate.
Decreased Excavator's fuel usage.
Adjusted Excavators' and Front-End Loader's buckets. Big Excavator's bucket has a capacity of 2 Small Excavators' buckets. Front-End Loader's bucket has a capacity of 4 Small Excavators' buckets.
Increased Front-End Loader's fuel usage.
Increased Big Excavator's movement by 15%.
Increased Big Excavator's hydraulic speed by 10%.
Decreased Big Excavator's price.
Decreased Front-End Loader's reverse movement speed by 20%.
Increased Front-End Loader's price.
Decreased Bulldozer's fuel consumption.
Decreased Bulldozer's price.
Increased T3/T4/T5 machine prices.
Increased Frankenstein's price.
Decreased Dump Truck's price.
Increased Excavator Teeth's durability.
Increased Wheels' durability.
Increased Hydraulic Hoses' durability (for the Bulldozer, Small Excavator, and Big Excavator).
Increased Battery's durability.
Increased Magnetite Separator's Hose durability.
Increased Wave Table's Jets durability.
Increased River's water pressure distance.
Increased Blacksmith upgrades' price.
Increased Water's price.
Increased Gold Nugettator's price.
Increased the amount of gold at Rich Spots on claims.
Decreased the amount of gold at regular spots on claims.
Increased claims' rent prices (except Old Arnold's).
Increased claims' prices.
Decreased claims' rent provision rate (except Old Arnold's).
Decreased the frequency of breakdowns on Normal difficulty.
Decreased Mobile Wash Plant Worker's cost multiplier.
Increased ST Sluicebox Worker's cost multiplier.
Increased T-DJ Sluicebox Worker's cost multiplier.
Decreased Bulldozer Worker's cost multiplier.
Increased Drill Worker's cost multiplier.
Increased Mechanic's cost multiplier.
Mechanic now charges X percent of particular part's cost for X percent of the part fixed. There is no longer a flat rate per the percentage of the part fixed.
Decreased Worker's retraining cost.
Decreased the chance of bear attacking the cable.
Minor Tutorial balance changes.


Fixes & Optimization:

Added culling to machines, which are out of sight (optimization). 
Disabled Trommel, Shaker, and Duplex Jig animations when out of sight (optimization).
Reduced machine computations for the machines, which are currently not being used (optimization).
Hoses and cables optimization.
Fixed blinking tree shadows.
The hoses are now reset if they fell below the ground level. They are transferred to the shelves near the storage area.
Adjusted the initial position of the bowl to make it possible to lower the pan from the beginning without moving it (on the gamepad).
Fixed dirt's texture in buckets.
Corrected specifications in the laptop.
Trees' shadows are now dependent on graphics settings.
Fixed gold bar purchase double-press bug on a gamepad.

Hello Miners!
Leaderboards Seasons 02 will start on April 16 (Tuesday)!

For the second season of gold mining competition, we are adding a new parameter: best Gold per Season ratio (Seasonal Gold). The game will count the highest amount of gold dug during any of the in-game seasons (full year). The score will be updated whenever Player gets a better score, so it will be continuously updated during the first in-game season, and then it will start updating again when Player reaches better score than during the first in-game season.

In other words, Players will now be competing in two leaderboards (Max Gold and Seasonal Gold), and the TOP10 lists may differ depending on the parameter. Winners will again be rewarded with a new special vehicle skin.

Prepare yourselves!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/5697c94cb4969ddb27d4d19f11a5260a181087cf.gif

Hello Gold Miners!
Update 1.5.2 is LIVE and it brings:

Leaderboards
New and updated national skins for Pickup Truck
and more!

Full changelog below.

Watch trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dc0sjU1LPSc

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/8f8ce2bacf7fd72c5b84632a7af7276b17d1d294.png
Leaderboards
Just as Gold Rush TV Series mine bosses you can now compare your gold totals with other players in Leaderboards!
Start playing in new Leaderboards mode and earn your place in rankings.
Good to know:

Balance values are drawn from the New Normal Mode.
Player's score shows the total amount of gold dug and real-life playing time spent to achieve it.
Score sums the amount of gold dug in consecutive in-game seasons.
Leaderboards will be reset from time to time, but the history of previous seasons will remain (top players + player's score).
You can get a special reward (vehicle skin) for being one of the top players in Leaderboards.
Save files from non-active (reset) Leaderboards will become Normal Mode saves and you will be able to continue playing on that save file.
It's not possible to share save file from active Leaderboards.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/619e3fdbbe2a9837a69b5de6e73d4a1e97c21956.gif
New and updated national skins for Pickup Truck
Did you know, that most of translations are made by our awesome community members? ❤ We want to appreciate their hard work and devotion, by adding new Pickup Truck vehicle skins.
ps There will be at least one more added to the game in one of the upcoming updates: Romanian. @Jimmy - we didn't forget about you!

Changelog

Added Leaderboards mode.
Added Leaderboards tab in Leaderboards mode for players to compare their total amount of gold dug.
Added new and updated existing Pickup Truck's national flag vehicle skins.
Changed balance values for Normal Mode. It used to have the same values as Easy Mode, but now it's more balanced between Easy and Hard Modes.  Players will have a single opportunity to decide, whether they want to switch to New Normal Mode or switch to Easy Mode (which has the same balance values as previous Normal Mode).
Workers now only apply to work on machines, which player currently possesses.
Blocked possibility to quick-load the game when it's saving.
Increased Wave Table's capacity.
Doubled Dump Truck's and Conveyor Belt's capacity.
Increased Front-End Loader's hydraulic speed.
All purchased machines start with 20% fuel.
Added Mechanic icon above items that are currently being repaired by a Mechanic.
Added provision for gold panning and washing dirt in the Wavetable when in Town.
Frankenstein's Belt icon turns off on HUD when the fuel runs out in the second engine.
Added new prompt informing about an empty fuel tank in Frankenstein's second engine.
Increased Map's zoom in value.
Updated Gold Rush posters and banners in Town and tent.
Changed save files description to include difficulty level and season.
Default keybindings are now displayed in Tutorial's prompts.
Reversed Excavator's scoop keys in Tutorial's prompt.
Added new Excavator digging prompts in the Tutorial.
Changed prompt's background.
Added background to Pressure System texts.
Vehicle paint UI changes.
Workers UI changes.


Fixes:

Fixed Front-End Loader's bucket sticking to Dump Truck's bed.
Mobile Washplant's indicators should no longer disappear after leaving the claim and going back from Town.
Fixed Conveyor Belt's infinite energy exploit.
Fixed bug with River not filling when the player is sleeping.
Corrected Mobile Water Tank's button animation.
Fixed camera's stutter when moving and rotating the camera.
Fixed Pickup Truck's LOD.
Fixed Hog Pan Core's worker bug - worker is now increasing the efficiency (amount of gold) instead of filling hog pan mats faster.
Fixed inability to finish the tutorial if unlocking all laptop tabs on 1$ mode before receiving the appropriate quest task.
Fixed bug with birds' sounds not being played during summer.
Fixed Mobile Water Tank's steering.
Fixed inability to switch camera and vehicle when reaching Season 10.
Fixed Magnetite Separator's particles.
Fixed prompt's issue with the first gold nugget having 0.66 at the end.
Fixed bug with Sluicebox Grates disappearing after loading the game if not attached to Sluicebox.
Fixed End-of-the-year summary statistics bug.
Fixed bug with 1,111 value on Small Water Pump.
Fixed walking sound in the night on asphalt.
Fixed driving sound in the night on asphalt.
Fixed wheel's sound - it no longer plays broken wheel's sound when repaired.
Fixed Magnetite Trailer exploit with unprocessed dirt.
Fixed Sluicebox Grate LOD.
Fixed sound of nugget dropped to a jar.
Fixed Excavator's Arm sound.
Fixed notifications prompt.
Fixed Drill's LOD - it should no longer glow
Fixed Mobile Washplant's blinking icons.
Fixed fuel usage bug.
Gamepad UI fixes
Minor optimization improvements.
Other Leaderboards UI changes & fixes.


Thank you!
We'd like to thank all beta testers, who helped us polish this update. Your suggestions were well-aimed and your reports - specific. You're awesome!

Feedback
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/
Your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it, we'd be grateful if you could leave a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

Now let's get digging!

notes.title: Update 1.5.1 is LIVE - Pressure & Power System
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/3ec36ff00c6db7fe123086c58b8fa50ea7a5de2a.jpg

Happy Holidays Prospectors!
We wish you all the best and have a little gift for you.
Gold Rush: The Game has just been updated with:

Pressure System
Power System
Christmas Gift
And more!

Full changelog below.

Watch trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r8ddt8UjMXc
Pressure & Power System Guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1590532120
Changelog:

Implemented Water Pressure System.
Implemented Electrical Power System.
Added Mobile Water Tank to the shop.
Added Water Towers to claims. Each Water Tower (apart from the one in town) costs 150,000$ to build. Refilling the Tower costs money, but it has two hose inputs (medium and large) so it can be additionally supplied with water from the River.
Added Water Tower with infinite water in Town.
The River is now affected by Summer and Winter conditions.  It dries out when the temperature is higher than 25 Celsius degrees and freezes when the temperature is lower than -2 Celsius degrees (the effect is not immediate).
Added Christmas Tree in town with a Christmas Gift.
Mobile Washplant's Performance increased.
Big Water Pump can move water from the River.
Increased the amount of gold dug at the bottom of the ground.
Fixed Bulldozer's missing wheel.
(Photosensitivity) Added the possibility to disable thunderbolts visual effect.
Water in the Tutorial is supplied from the Water Tower via the Big Pump.
Changed one of Tutorial's quest tasks: Players are now required to collect 120k$ instead of 400k$.
Updated game's Credits.
Minor localization changes.


Thank you!
We'd like to thank all beta testers, who helped us polish this update. Your suggestions were well-aimed and your reports - specific. You're awesome!

Feedback
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/
Your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it, we'd be grateful if you could leave a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

notes.title: Update 1.5.1 is LIVE!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/2b1af121c49cd6829b110ce33a01f1cb8d2f4f52.jpg

Hello Prospectors!
Update 1.5.1.11018 is LIVE and it brings:

Balance Changes (improved digging)
Tutorial Improvements
Bug Fixes
And more.

Full changelog below.

IMPORTANT: We had to temporarily disable the Steam Cloud Synchronization due to an issue with the deleted save files reported by some Players. We are now investigating the issue and hope to fix it in the coming days. For now, please remember to copy your save files if you wish to transfer them to another drive.
Here's how to find them:

Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
Enter the following without the quotes: '%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Saves'
Copy the content of the entire folder.


Balance changes:

Changed Excavator's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
Changed Front-End Loader's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
Reduced Front-End ability to push dirt.
Changed starting fuel of any machine to 20%.
All washplant containers fill evenly at the same rate.
Increased prices of T4 & T5 machines.
Reduced claim upgrade prices.
Changed shop prices.
Changed machine park prices.
Changed Seasons' price multiplier.
Adjusted destroyable Parts lifetime.
Changed the multiplier of failures during Summer and Winter.
Lowered the multiplier of parts durability during Seasons on Hard Mode.
Lowered the multiplier of Fuel price on Hard Mode.
Other balance changes.


Tutorial:

Added Tier 2 tutorial.
Added Tier 3 assembly tutorial.
Added possibility to end the tutorial at any time (currently only on the keyboard).
Added new tutorial steps to the existing quest tasks.
Changed order of Small Excavator and Mobile Washplant quest tasks in the tutorial.
Changed several tutorial quest task texts.
Added new yellow markers (quest task indicators) to better guide the Player.
Added more godrays (yellow beams) on the road to the Old Arnold claim.
Adjusted existing yellow markers (quest task indicators) positions.
Added yellow markers, which are displayed in the corner of the screen, if the godray is not visible in Players' sight.
Changed headers of tutorial tasks (T1, T2, etc.).
Disabled possibility to use the bucket on machines, that are not in quest task.
Changed Tutorial starting season from Spring to Summer.
Added new task after smelting first gold bar. Players are now required to get 20k dollars.
Fueling quest tasks are skipped if the player has full fuel tanks.
Quest tasks, which require to collect a specific amount of gold, are skipped if the player is playing with 1$ Mode enabled.
Disabled the day summary at the beginning of the tutorial.
Other minor tutorial fixes.


Other:

Changed Stock graph in the Bank to better reflect the changes after Four Seasons Cycle Update. As each Season has 10 days, the Graph is now divided into 40 days.
Name of the highlighted item is now displayed.
Allowed Hog Pan Container worker to be assigned to Hog Pan No Pump.
Added ladders to washplant areas on each claim to make it easier to reach ST sluiceboxes.
Small Shovel is now third in order. Players can use it by pressing [3] key on keyboard.
Added numbers under Tools icons.
Added 'Stories' text to the icon.
Changed category of Miners Moss and Hog Pan Mats to Accessories in the online shop.
"Sell Gold Bar" button is now greyed out when there's no gold bar chosen.
Removed popup window informing about the addition of Four Seson Cycle to the game.
Added possibility to assign workers to the already assigned machines. They will be added instead of the previous worker.
Included Backpack Key shortcut in the in-game "Show Controls" menu (under [Z] key). 
Changed Gamepad scrolling in the online shop.
Added "Back" button after choosing the game difficulty.
Minor localization changes.


Fixes:

Fixed bug with the game crashing during autosave.
Optimization of scenes.
Fixed bug, which prevented some players from continuing the tutorial after filling the hog pan up to 30%.
Fixed blinking shadows on Ultra quality.
Fixed double-clicking bug when selling gold bars in the Bank (only one click is required now).
Fixed Frankenstein's belt bug.
Added missing sound to Loans tab in the Bank.
Fixed Gold Nugget notifications displaying in different units than the ones chosen in Settings.
Fixed Frankenstein's collision after loading the save file.
Fixed Rivertown's bedrock dirt bug (the dirt look like it's diggable, but it wasn't).
Fixed Laptop's transport prompt.
Mobile Washplant textures fixes.
Fixed 0oz gold bar bug.
Fixed bug which allowed to loan the same claim multiple times despite already renting it.
FIxed bug, which allowed to add 0 amount of any machinery to the order and proceed with it to check out in the heavy machinery park.
Removed snow texture from gold bars.
Transport UI fixes.
Minor SFX fixes.
Minor UI fixes. 
Minor localization fixes.


Gamepad Fixes:

Disabled Dump Truck's bed moving with gamepad's stick.
Added a slight cooldown on the gamepad for changing the number of items in the laptop (values no longer increase without limit when leaning the stick - the counter stops at some point).
Fixed Front-End Loader's faulty bucket on the gamepad. It might be required to reset gamepad controls to default in game's settings.
Fixed Transport bug on the gamepad, which prevented players from taking any actions, after transporting anything from the right side of the Transport menu. 
Fixed bug with white squares displayed instead of button icons when returning from shop menus on the gamepad.
Fixed gamepad controls when using the map for the first time.
Fixed bug, which prevented players from renting parcels after switching back from the gamepad.
Added possibility to upgrade workers on the gamepad.
Added possibility to reject workers on the gamepad.
Added possibility to assign workers on the gamepad.
Added possibility to unselect workers on the gamepad.
Fixed inability to move lists of items in online shop when using the gamepad.
Added popup informing about rejecting workers application of firing a worker on the gamepad.
Other minor gamepad UI fixes.


Thank you!

We've just opened the Open Beta branch on Steam for you to check the upcoming update. We're mainly tweaking game's balance and tutorial.

Primarily, we've managed to change the digging's feeling of Front-End Loader and Excavator. We'd love to hear your opinions on the changes. You can help us make the game more enjoyable for you.
Once you give Open Beta Update a try, please join the discussion on our channels:

Steam Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/10/
Discord (#beta-general channel): https://discordapp.com/invite/goldrush-thegame

Open Beta branch is a voluntary option and it may not reflect the quality and content of actual Anniversary Update 1.5.1.
Save files from Open Beta version won't be transferred to a live build.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1346397630

Balance changes:

Changed Excavator's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
Changed Front-End Loader's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
Changed starting fuel of any machine to 20%.

Reduced Front-End ability to push dirt.
Reduced claim upgrade prices.
Changed shop prices.
Changed machine park prices.
Changed Seasons' price multiplier.
Adjusted destroyable Parts lifetime.
Changed the multiplier of failures during Summer and Winter.
Lowered the multiplier of parts durability during Seasons on Hard Mode.
Lowered the multiplier of Fuel price on Hard Mode.


Tutorial:

Added Tier 2 tutorial.
Added Tier 3 assembly tutorial.
Added new tutorial steps to the existing quest tasks.
Disabled possibility to use the bucket on machines, that are not in quest task.
Added new yellow markers (quest task indicators).
Adjusted existing yellow markers (quest task indicators) positions.
Added new task after smelting first gold bar. Players are now required to get 42k dollars.
Fueling quest tasks are skipped if the player has full fuel tanks.
Changed Tutorial starting season from Spring to Summer.

Other minor tutorial fixes.


Other:

Name of the highlighted item is now displayed.
Added 'Stories' text to the icon.
Small Shovel is now third in order. Players can use it by pressing [3] key on keyboard.
Removed popup window informing about the addition of Four Seson Cycle to the game.


Fixes:

Optimization of scenes.
Fixed double-clicking bug when selling gold bars in the Bank (only one click is required now).
Added missing sound to Loans tab in the Bank.
Fixed Frankenstein's collision after loading the save file.
Fixed Rivertown's bedrock dirt bug (the dirt look like it's diggable, but it wasn't).
Fixed bug, which prevented some players from continuing the tutorial after filling the hog pan up to 30%.
Fixed Laptop's transport prompt.
Fixed bug which allowed to loan the same claim multiple times despite already renting it.

notes.title: Gold Rush: The Game - Anniversary Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/cf74983acc8bc86dcff166d33bb02ead94f13118.jpg

Hello Players!
Gold Rush: The Game is celebrating it's 1st anniversary with a huge Anniversary Update, featuring:

Four Seasons Cycle
Achievements
Reversed Tutorial
and more!


Full changelog below.

Release trailer
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jCLzQsaKpNQ

Four Seasons Cycle
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/a52ca659afcfd02b6c23173a751a314161f06f0b.gif
Experience harsh Alaskan Winter and get excited about new gold mining season with the first Spring breeze.

Achievements
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/86030107f49f08e7acc5e32046d83dcd6c49ad6d.gif
Show off your gold mining experience with Steam achievements. Can you get them all?

Reversed Tutorial
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/a11e368687c7d3f860413a7119d266373e743ca9.gif
Start with all the best toys and... see for yourself!


Features:

Seasons - gameplay is now affected by weather conditions:
- Spring,
- Summer,
- Autumn,
- Winter.
(description of Seasons and weather conditions below)
Spring, Summer, and Autumn last 10 in-game days.
Winter can last up to 7 in-game days, but players can finish it earlier in the Hotel in town.
Added story popup after moving to the hotel in Winter.
After loading the old save file, players start at Season 3 Day 1 (Spring).
Prices in Shop are changing with each passing day. Increasing towards Summer and decreasing towards Winter.
Added Fahrenheit temperature scale. You can enable it, by switching Units Type to Imperial (in Settings).
Added new HUD indicators:
- Season,
- weather,
- temperature,
- days till next Season.
Added a new summary window of Days and Seasons.
Added rewards (Jars of gold displayed in the Tent) for finishing each full gold mining season (from Spring to Winter). Maximum amount of jars is 7.
Added weather-related prompts.
Added Achievements (full list below).
Changed existing Tutorial to Reversed Tutorial. From now on players start with Tier 3 equipment and learn basic gameplay mechanics.
Difficulty modes added (accessible from 'New Game' in Main Menu):
- Easy,
- Normal,
- Hard,
- Leaderboards (coming soon).
Difficulty modes' features descriptions are visible when starting New Game.
Difficulty level can't be changed during the game.
Added menu with level difficulty choice for old saves.
Added information about overriding save files.
Added Prompt informing about the necessity to turn the engine on when not being able to drive. It does not disappear until the engine is turned on.
New epilepsy warning popup window.
Added Cancel button to Main Menu.
Collector's Edition Upgrade content is now accessible from Main Menu.
Added Left and Right Trigger button icons to Main Menu.
Added "Back" button to Journal.
Added possibility to switch Journal bookmarks on a gamepad.
Pressing [A] button on Play in Main Menu will move the active selection to the window below.
Updated localizations.


Bug fixes:

Stories Radar no longer locks when in Pickup Truck.
Fixed menu background not blurring when changing controller buttons.
DigTube UI fixes.
Gamepad UI fixes.
UI prompts fixes.
Menu buttons UI fixes.
Controls UI fixes (controller buttons should be displayed correctly after returning from Pause Menu).
Added missing gamepad button icons (previously displayed as white squares).
Journal gamepad fixes.


Seasons description
Spring

Big Repairs - If you haven't put your equipment to the hangar or transport storage space, you're in a bit of a hole... Everything that could be broken will be broken.
Animal Attacks - From time to time an animal can attack your claim (Popup event). There is a chance that your employee will be attacked and will be inactive for a while (information will be displayed in the Workers tab on the laptop) or the animal can break your cables/hoses (you will need to replace them).
Meltdown - Earth is still a bit frozen, so you need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If the temperature is low, the earth should still freeze over time. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
Prices - Regular prices in the shop. All prices will vary day to day across the season.


Summer

High Temperature - What a blistering heat! Machines break faster.
Fainting - Workers can faint and be inactive for a while.
Prices - Higher prices in the shop.


Autumn

Heavy Rain - Electrical equipment is breaking faster. Wash Plant is breaking faster because of the dense and wet earth. Vehicles have less traction.
Storm - The Laptop is off (no signal).
Thunderstruck - At the beginning of the storm, thunderstruck can hit your big generator. There is a chance for each part connected to break as a result.
Prices - Regular prices in the shop.


Winter

Permafrost - Earth is frozen. You need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
Freeze - Vehicles are breaking way faster. When the temperature is very low, hoses can break if the connected equipment is turned off, but the water pump is still running. Workers can get sick and be inactive for a while.
Fuel - Higher fuel usage.
Prices - Lower prices in the shop.


Summary
When you try to end the gold mining season but left something outside the hangar, you will receive a prompt about not securing every breakable equipment.
A summary with all your stats will be displayed, after finishing the gold mining season at the Hotel (in the middle of Winter).
You won't be able to finish the season before the winter comes.
After ending the season there you will receive an additional small trophy (jar) with the amount of gold you've collected during the last gold mining season.

Achievements list
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/451340/achievements

Thank you!
We want to thank all players, who helped us past those 365 days and supported us. We wouldn't be here without you!

Now let's get digging!

notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/f1ec4f730317b12c712564fa7fc6c372aa6fe598.jpg

Hello Players,
we have a gift for you!
We're excited, that so many of you are here with us already (and still coming)! 
After updating the game, you will be able to get new Pickup Truck paint jobs with 16 national flags.

Although we'd love to include flags of all countries, we had to limit the amount to the ones with the highest percentage of players.

Two leaders of virtual gold mining also received symbols along the flag. 

We would like to add symbols to other flags as well, but we need your help!
Let us know in the comment section, what symbols would you like to have included with other 14 national flags

Please treat others with respect. Any comments that are chauvinistic, offensive, or based on prejudicial stereotypes will be deleted and may result in a ban.

Apart from that, new Update includes some minor changes and bug fixes. Full changelog below:

Changelog:

Corrected cash conversion rate for selling magnetite.
Reduced gold bar smelting cost in the tutorial to 0.
Blacksmith UI fixes
Paint Shop UI fixes
Paint Shop UI rework
Added new vehicle paint jobs with national flags:
   - Germany
   - United States
   - United Kingdom
   - Canada
   - France
   - Netherlands 
   - Australia
   - Austria
   - Norway
   - Sweden

notes.title: Hard Mode - balance tweaks
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We're introducing yet another Hard Mode balance changes, based on your suggestions.

Changelog:

Amount of gold on Hog Pan areas: 1.55x -> 1.25x
Excavator's teeth durability: +150% of previous value
Amount of gold on Claims:  0.42x -> 0.36x
Fuel consumption: 1.25x -> 1.18x


How to understand the values:
e.g. "1.55x" is the multiplier of Normal Mode's value

Discussion
As it turned out to be a widely discussed topic, we have opened a dedicated Discord channel, in which everyone can share their feedback and suggestions regarding the Hard Mode (and other topics in the future).
➡ https://discord.gg/S9wJmsD
We are also participants in this conversation, with the aim to work out a perfect balance with you. Or should we say a "golden mean"? ;)

Now download the update and let's get digging!

notes.title: Update 1.4.2.8711 - Tutorial and Hard Mode are LIVE!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/c31dd54c8b435189887da33e33d9183d9c89f557.jpg

Hello Players,
With Update 1.4.2, we introduce free content for both rookie miners and experienced prospectors:

Tutorial
Hard Mode


Tutorial
We all have been greenhorns once. Gold mining is no easy business. It comes with a hard work and sacrifices. Thankfully, there's a tutorial. - Bought machines, except pickup truck and trailers, will not show in on city map, so you will not be able to reset them (this caused situation when players had machines in the city while they should be operated only on claim)

Balance changes:
- Smallest flake of gold has fixed weight 0.001oz

Other:
- On the beginning of the game prompt will show up telling about journal and digtube
- After buying stuff in shop prompt will show up telling where to search for bought goods
- After buying stuff in machine shop prompt will show up telling how to transport machines to claims
- VSYNC has been disabled as this cause a lot of crashes, when we figure it out we will enable it

notes.content:

Gold Material - Now, gold should be golden again.
